episodes.title: Slumber Party Panic
episodes.summary: Princess Bumblegum's latest experiment accidentally unleashes an undead horde upon the Candy Kingdom.

episodes.title: Trouble in Lumpy Space
episodes.summary: Jake is bitten by Lumpy Space Princess and begins to transform into a Lumpy being. In order to find a cure, Finn is travels to Lumpy Space.

episodes.title: Prisoners of Love
episodes.summary: After the Ice King kidnaps a large group of princesses, its up to Finn and Jake to free them.

episodes.title: Tree Trunks
episodes.summary: Tree Trunks joins Finn and Jake on an quest, but finds her talents for adventuring leave something to be desired.

episodes.title: The Enchiridion!
episodes.summary: Finn and Jake go on a quest for the titular magical book that would prove them worthy of being righteous heroes. After passing through a series of trials and tribulations, Finn acquires the legendary book.

episodes.title: The Jiggler
episodes.summary: A strange creature attracted by Finn's auto-tuned singing voice follows the duo to their home and they keep him as a pet. Soon, however, the creature begins to show signs of sickness, and Finn and Jake realize the creature needs the love and attention of its mother. They then return it to its nest.

episodes.title: Ricardio the Heart Guy
episodes.summary: Finn believes that Princess Bubblegum's new friend, a literal heart named Ricardio is evil and is proven right after learning that Ricardio is the heart of the Ice King. Ricardio reveals that he wants to "make out" with Bubblegum's heart, but he is defeated by Finn and Jake.

episodes.title: Business Time
episodes.summary: Finn and Jake fall victim to their own laziness when they delegate their adventuring responsibilities to a group of businessmen they thawed from an iceberg. Eventually, the businessmen's efficiency causes them to become hazards to others, and they are refrozen into an iceberg.

episodes.title: My Two Favorite People
episodes.summary: Jake feels overwhelmed at not having enough time for Finn and his girlfriend, Lady Rainicorn, so he tries to get them to hang out more. Eventually, Finn and Lady Raincorn become closer than Jake is comfortable with, and he starts feeling jealous.

episodes.title: Memories of Boom Boom Mountain
episodes.summary: Finn, motivated by an upsetting experience when he was a baby, tries to reconfirm his desire for helping people out when confronted with one problem after another stemming from a violence-hating mountain.

episodes.title: Finn the Wizard
episodes.summary: Finn and Jake are coaxed by a skeleton man to enroll in a course for free magic powers. After becoming full-fledged wizards, they realize they were tricked into helping stop an asteroid for all of eternity. Finn rejects the status quo and thinks of a different way to avert the crisis.

episodes.title: Evicted!
episodes.summary: Finn and Jake search the land of Ooo for a new home after a vampire queen named Marceline claims the duo's treehouse as her own. Eventually, Marceline relents, because she thinks Finn and Jake are "cool".

episodes.title: City of Thieves
episodes.summary: Finn and Jake, in hopes of helping a little girl named Penny get back her stolen basket, enter into a city where everyone is a thief, and become slowly corrupted by their surroundings.

episodes.title: The Witch's Garden
episodes.summary: After Jake steals one of the Witch's donuts, she steals Jake's powers and won't give them back unless he apologizes to her. During a series of events trying to find a way to get Jake's powers back, Finn's life is then held on the line, but will Jake's new laziness get the best of him?

episodes.title: What is Life?
episodes.summary: Finn creates a Never-Ending Pie-Throwing Robot (Neptr) to prank Jake, but it unexpectedly comes to life! Yet when he decides to use some of the Ice King's power to further develop it, this ultimately leads to a moral dilemma for the new living machine.

episodes.title: Ocean of Fear
episodes.summary: Finn discovers he's afraid of the ocean, so he enlists Jake's help to overcome his fear or risk failure.

episodes.title: When Wedding Bells Thaw
episodes.summary: The Ice King is finally getting married, but consults Finn and Jake on whether or not to go through with getting hitched or keeping his life of abducting princesses.

episodes.title: Dungeon
episodes.summary: Finn descends into a dungeon in hopes of finding adventure, but ultimately finding various obstacles that better fit being handled by Jake than himself alone.

episodes.title: The Duke
episodes.summary: During a mishap accidentally caused by Finn,Princess Bubblegum becomes green and bald, and blames the Duke of Nuts for it, thus making Finn think he's a bad guy. Finn and Jake have no choice but to find the Duke of Nuts on Bubblegum's order.

episodes.title: Freak City
episodes.summary: After a magic man turns Finn into a giant foot, he and Jake team up with a band of similar body part freaks to set things right and try to turn themselves back to normal.

episodes.title: Donny
episodes.summary: When Finn and Jake see a bullying ogre named Donny, they help him turn his life around, unaware of the ecological consequences of their action.

episodes.title: Henchman
episodes.summary: Finn takes the place of Marceline's henchman, and he finds out how hard it is to obey her strange ways.

episodes.title: Rainy Day Daydream
episodes.summary: When a knife storm forces Finn and Jake to stay inside, they discover the out-of-control power of Jake's imagination.

episodes.title: What Have You Done?
episodes.summary: Finn and Jake capture Ice King under order of Princess Bubblegum without even knowing what he has done wrong.

episodes.title: Finn Meets His Hero
episodes.summary: Finn and Jake discover Billy, the greatest hero who ever lived, and try to help other people without using violence in their methods.

episodes.title: The Gut Grinder
episodes.summary: When the gold owned by several beings were devoured by a creature called the "Gut Grinder," Finn and Jake set out to discover who the culprit is, while trying to sustain Jake's thoughts that he is the actual Gut Grinder.

episodes.title: It Came from the Nightosphere
episodes.summary: Finn summons the Lord of Evil to reconcile with his daughter, Marceline the Vampire Queen, but ends up unleashing him on the unsuspecting land.

episodes.title: The Eyes
episodes.summary: One night, an exhausted Finn and Jake are creeped out by an odd-looking horse that mysteriously appears outside the treehouse and keeps them awake. They try everything they can think of to get rid of the freaky horse, but nothing seems to work.

episodes.title: Loyalty to the King
episodes.summary: There's a new "Nice King" in Ooo, and he looks kinda like someone else we know.

episodes.title: Blood Under the Skin
episodes.summary: Finn goes on an embarrassing quest to get armor to fit in with some really cool knights.

episodes.title: Storytelling
episodes.summary: When Jake becomes sick, the only thing that can cure him is a good story, so he asks Finn to go out and find one. The story must have excitement, romance, suspense and, of course, a happy ending. But when nothing interesting happens, Finn tries to make the story happen, accidentally turning the forest animals against each other... and him!

episodes.title: Slow Love
episodes.summary: A lonely snail lookin' for love literally crashes into the treehouse and asks Finn and Jake for help. Now our heroes must teach this snail how to get a girlfriend before he destroys their home!

episodes.title: Power Animal
episodes.summary: Finn is kidnapped by a group of gnomes, who want to harness his energy to take over the world. Only Jake can save his best friend... if he can just focus long enough to follow the obvious clues and rescue Finn.

episodes.title: Crystals Have Power
episodes.summary: Jake takes a vow of non-violence which is inconvenient when they're attacked by marauders from the crystal dimension.

episodes.title: The Other Tarts
episodes.summary: Finn and Jake volunteer for a dangerous assignment: carrying rare tarts for a meeting of Ooo royalty.

episodes.title: To Cut a Woman's Hair
episodes.summary: Finn needs to find a princess willing to give up a lock of her hair to save Jake from a balding witch.

episodes.title: The Chamber of Frozen Blades
episodes.summary: In Ninja-mode, Finn and Jake break into Ice King's palace to catch him red-handed.

episodes.title: Her Parents
episodes.summary: Jake pretends to be a rainicorn in order to make Lady's parents like him.

episodes.title: The Pods
episodes.summary: Finn takes up a quest from a dying knight to protect three magic beans: two good, one evil. But when he and Jake decide to plant the beans to eliminate the evil once and for all, will they be able to figure out which is which in time?

episodes.title: The Silent King
episodes.summary: After Finn deposes the spank-happy king of Goblins, he becomes the king of goblins to prevent strife. But they and their strange rules prove not to his liking.

episodes.title: The Real You
episodes.summary: Finn, who has to give a speech at Princess Bubblegum's science barbecue, seeks a quick fix to make himself smarter. However, he does so by getting a pair of glasses with very strange effects.

episodes.title: Guardians of Sunshine
episodes.summary: Finn and Jake trick BMO into letting them into the video game called Guardians of Sunshine, where they attempt to defeat an unbeatable video game in a 3-D digital environment.

episodes.title: Death in Bloom
episodes.summary: After accidentally killing Princess Bubblegum's beloved plant, Finn and Jake travel to the land of the dead to bring it back to life.

episodes.title: Susan Strong
episodes.summary: Having always believed he is the only human left in the Land of Ooo, Finn believes he has discovered a tribe to primitive humans living underground.

episodes.title: Mystery Train
episodes.summary: While traveling on a train, Finn and Jake find themselves in the middle of a murder mystery.

episodes.title: Go with Me
episodes.summary: Jake and Marceline give Finn conflicting advise on how to ask out Princess Bubblegum.

episodes.title: Belly of the Beast
episodes.summary: Finn and Jake must save a group of clueless, party-minded teddy bears living inside the belly of a monster.

episodes.title: The Limit
episodes.summary: An enormous maze tests the limit of Jake's stretching power.

episodes.title: Video Makers
episodes.summary: Finn and Jake set out to make their own movie, but have conflicting visions of what their movie should be.

episodes.title: Mortal Folly
episodes.summary: The Lich, the greatest form of pure evil in the land of Ooo, is accidentally unleashed. With the highest stakes, Finn and Jake set out on the most serious adventure of their career.

episodes.title: Mortal Recoil
episodes.summary: With the evil Lich seemingly defeated, Finn and Jake are uneasy with their success because of its great cost.

episodes.title: Heat Signature
episodes.summary: Finn and Jake ask Marceline the Vampire Queen to turn them into vampires. However, she isn't interested in transforming her friends and tricks them into thinking she has.

episodes.title: The Conquest of Cuteness
episodes.summary: Finn and Jake must defend their home from the Cuties, a tiny race who believe themselves to be evil, destructive invaders.

episodes.title: Morituri te Salutamus
episodes.summary: The duo choose to partake in gladiatorial combat against the Fight King's ghost warriors, but Finn succumbs to blood-lust while Jake becomes obsessed in keeping a cool morale.

episodes.title: Memory of a Memory
episodes.summary: Finn and Jake enter Marceline's mind to awaken her from a sleep spell she had cast on herself, without knowing that they are being tricked by a person from her past.

episodes.title: Hitman
episodes.summary: The grounded Ice King hires a fire-manipulating hitman to hit Finn and Jake, without realizing the potentially deadly consequences.

episodes.title: Too Young
episodes.summary: The Earl of Lemongrab takes over the Candy Kingdom due to Princess Bubblegum's age regression, forcing her and Finn to try and get rid of him even if it means a life-altering decision.

episodes.title: The Monster
episodes.summary: The king and queen of Lumpy Space ask Finn and Jake to bring their daughter back home. At the same time, they attempt to stop a "monster" from destroying a village.

episodes.title: Still
episodes.summary: Ice King freezes Finn and Jake with a potion so he can force them to befriend him.

episodes.title: Wizard Battle
episodes.summary: Finn and Jake enter a competition for wizards in disguise so they can prevent Ice King from winning the grand prize: a kiss from Princess Bubblegum.

episodes.title: Adventure Time with Fionna and Cake
episodes.summary: Fionna (the gender-swapped version of Finn) puts up with the sudden courtship of Prince Gumball (the gender-swapped version of Princess Bubblegum) while taking advice from her partner Cake (the gender-swapped version of Jake) in dealing with guys.

episodes.title: What Was Missing
episodes.summary: Finn, Jake, BMO, Marceline, and Princess Bubblegum must come together and play music as a genuine band in order to open the gate of the Door Lord and retrieve their stolen items.

episodes.title: Apple Thief
episodes.summary: When Tree Trunks' apples go missing, she, Finn and Jake descend into the dark side of the Candy Kingdom in order to find the thief.

episodes.title: The Creeps
episodes.summary: Finn, Jake, and some friends attend a dinner with a mysterious host. However, the host then reveals himself as a murderous ghost that will possess the body of one guest to kill everyone else. The night turns from a masquerade party into a terrifying whodunit as the guests start to get murdered one by one.

episodes.title: From Bad to Worse
episodes.summary: When another plague of Candy Zombies arises and Princess Bubblegum is among the undead, Finn and his friends are in a race against time to figure out how to stop it... but things get worse by the minute.

episodes.title: Beautopia
episodes.summary: Susan Strong returns and asks Finn and Jake to help fight off the Lub Glubs and regain her people's home in Beautopia.

episodes.title: No One Can Hear You
episodes.summary: Finn and Jake stop an unearthly stag when Finn finds that his legs are broke, Jake has gone crazy, and all the Candy People are missing.

episodes.title: Jake vs. Me-Mow
episodes.summary: Me-Mow, a tiny assassin cat, hides in Jake's nose and orders him to kill Wildberry Princess or face death by injecting poison.

episodes.title: Thank You
episodes.summary: A Snow Golem takes in a lost Fire Wolf pup and tries to take care of it, while Finn and Jake try to break open the Ice King's suit of ice armor for taking their sandwiches.

episodes.title: The New Frontier
episodes.summary: Finn tries to stop Jake from embracing a dream that he believes foretells his final demise.

episodes.title: Holly Jolly Secrets Part I
episodes.summary: In Finn and Jake's holiday special, the heroes come across a video diary of the Ice King's and attempt to decipher its secrets.

episodes.title: Holly Jolly Secrets Part II
episodes.summary: In part two of the holiday special, The Ice King tries to get his video diary back from Finn and Jake.

episodes.title: Marceline's Closet
episodes.summary: Finn and Jake play Cloud Hunt in Marceline's house, but they get trapped in her closet after she comes home.

episodes.title: Paper Pete
episodes.summary: Finn tries to resolve a secret library war between the Pagelings and the Moldos.

episodes.title: Another Way
episodes.summary: When Clown Nurses make Finn uncomfortable, Finn ignores all options except his own when he decides to get cyclops tears to heal his and Jake's broken toes.

episodes.title: Ghost Princess
episodes.summary: Finn and Jake head into Ghost Princess' Cemetery to find the cause of her death while she finds true love, ultimately revealing her tragic past.

episodes.title: Dad's Dungeon
episodes.summary: Jake feels conflicted when his father forces him to try and hold Finn back in a dungeon meant to toughen Finn up.

episodes.title: Incendium
episodes.summary: Trying to help Finn get over his hopeless feelings for Princess Bubblegum, Jake sets out to find a new princess for Finn to go out with.

episodes.title: Hot to the Touch
episodes.summary: Refusing to believe that she is evil, Finn tries to win over his new crush, Flame Princess.

episodes.title: Five Short Graybles
episodes.summary: Five short stories centered around a common theme: The five senses.

episodes.title: Web Weirdos
episodes.summary: When Finn gets trapped in a giant spider web, he ends up playing marriage counselor to a couple of grumpy arachnids.

episodes.title: Dream of Love
episodes.summary: Tree Trunks is courted by an oinking suitor, but much to everyone's dismay, their public displays of affection interfere with everyone's normal lives.

episodes.title: Return to the Nightosphere
episodes.summary: Finn and Jake find themselves imprisoned in the dark realm of the Nightosphere with no memory of how they came to be there.

episodes.title: Daddy's Little Monster
episodes.summary: Continuing their mysterious quest in the Nightosphere, Finn and Jake must rescue their friend Marceline the Vampire Queen.

episodes.title: In Your Footsteps
episodes.summary: A bear befriends Finn and Jake, but what are his true intentions?

episodes.title: Hug Wolf
episodes.summary: After an encounter with a Hug Wolf, Finn goes through a Jekyll and Hyde-like transformation, becoming a hug wolf himself.

episodes.title: Princess Monster Wife
episodes.summary: When Ooo's princesses start losing body parts, Finn and Jake investigate.

episodes.title: Goliad
episodes.summary: Princess Bubblegum is concerned over her mortality, and reveals her designated successor to Finn and Jake. However, things get out of control when the heir turns against Princess Bubblegum.

episodes.title: Beyond This Earthly Realm
episodes.summary: When Finn finds and touches a porcelain lamb, it transports him into the spirit world, and only the Ice King can help get him out

episodes.title: Gotcha!
episodes.summary: In order to do research for her tell-all memoir about men, Lumpy Space Princess goes undercover working for Finn and Jake.

episodes.title: Princess Cookie
episodes.summary: Finn and Jake are called to solve a Candy Kingdom hostage crisis when a rogue cookie takes over.

episodes.title: Card Wars
episodes.summary: Finn and Jake play an epic card game, where Jake becomes overly competitive.

episodes.title: Sons of Mars
episodes.summary: When Grob Gob Glob Grod comes to arrest Magic Man for his crimes, he switches bodies with Jake to escape his trials.

episodes.title: Burning Low
episodes.summary: Princess Bubblegum tries to warn Finn why he can't engage in a relationship with Flame Princess anymore, but Finn and Jake just think she's jealous.

episodes.title: BMO Noire
episodes.summary: BMO tries to solve the mystery of Finn's missing sock.

episodes.title: King Worm
episodes.summary: Finn has a vivid dream that may be more than it seems.

episodes.title: Lady & Peebles
episodes.summary: Princess Bubblegum and Lady Rainicorn look for Finn and Jake, who are missing after a run-in with the Ice King.

episodes.title: You Made Me
episodes.summary: Princess Bubblegum tries to find a way to help the weird and creepy Earl of Lemongrab after he begins to annoy and disturb her people with his disturbing ways.

episodes.title: Who Would Win
episodes.summary: Finn and Jake are determined to take down the Farm, but instead they fight each other for not training seriously.

episodes.title: Ignition Point
episodes.summary: Finn and Jake sneak into the Fire Kingdom to get Flame Princess' scented candles, and end up discovering a plot against the Flame King's life.

episodes.title: The Hard Easy
episodes.summary: Woobeewoo Villagers seek heroic protection from a monstrous frog who's attacking their swamp.

episodes.title: Reign of Gunters
episodes.summary: Gunter attempts to take over all of Ooo with the demonic wishing eye and the pink kitten, while it sends a distracted Ice King away.

episodes.title: I Remember You
episodes.summary: Ice King visits Marceline to ask for help in creating a song to attract princesses, but Marceline struggles to deal emotionally with his presence.

episodes.title: The Lich
episodes.summary: Finn has an unclear premonition involving The Lich and sets out to stop the undead creature.

episodes.title: Finn the Human
episodes.summary: Finn and Jake chase the Lich through a dimensional portal where they meet Prismo, who tells them that the Lich wished for the extinction of all life. This leads Finn to wish that the Lich "never even ever existed.

episodes.title: Jake the Dog
episodes.summary: Jake continues to watch the consequences of Finn's wish within the Time Room with Prismo. As the situation gets worse in the world of Finn's wish, Prismo tries to help Jake make the right wish to save both Finn and the entire world.

episodes.title: Five More Short Graybles
episodes.summary: Finn and Jake stick their thumbs in everything; Marceline tries to find her way to Wizard Bill's Music Shop; Ice King gets a new bride.

episodes.title: Up a Tree
episodes.summary: Finn and Jake are playing catch when Finn accidentally tosses their throwing disc into a gigantic tree.

episodes.title: All the Little People
episodes.summary: Magic Man secretly slips Finn a bag filled with miniature versions of Finn and all his friends.

episodes.title: Jake the Dad
episodes.summary: Jake's a daddy, but being a father and keeping his rainicorn pups from killing themselves or each other is a lot harder than he imagined.

episodes.title: Davey
episodes.summary: Finn can't go anywhere without folks stopping to thank him for being a hero.

episodes.title: Mystery Dungeon
episodes.summary: Ice King, NEPTR, Tree Trunks, Shelby and Lemongrab are trapped inside a mysterious dungeon and must work together to free themselves.

episodes.title: All Your Fault
episodes.summary: Princess Bubblegum sends Finn and Jake to investigate a message of distress from the Earls of Lemongrab.

episodes.title: Little Dude
episodes.summary: While Finn & Jake go swimming, Finn's hat magically comes to life!

episodes.title: Bad Little Boy
episodes.summary: The princesses are sick and tired of Ice King's crazy Fionna & Cake stories, so Marceline stops by the Ice Kingdom to show him how it's done.

episodes.title: Vault of Bones
episodes.summary: Finn's worried that Flame Princess still has evil tendencies in her and wants to shift her alignment to good.

episodes.title: The Great Bird Man
episodes.summary: Finn and Jake get lost in the badlands and are saved by Xergiok, ex-Goblin King who now lives in cave.

episodes.title: Simon & Marcy
episodes.summary: A look at what Ice King and Marceline were like 996 years ago.

episodes.title: A Glitch is a Glitch
episodes.summary: Ice King creates a computer virus to delete everybody except him and Princess Bubblegum.

episodes.title: Puhoy
episodes.summary: Stuck inside the treehouse during a sword storm, Jake builds a pillow fort while Finn goes to a different world.

episodes.title: BMO Lost
episodes.summary: BMO gets snatched away by a giant eagle and must find his way home.

episodes.title: Princess Potluck
episodes.summary: Ice King gets super jealous when he finds out that he wasn't invited to the Princess Potluck.

episodes.title: James Baxter the Horse
episodes.summary: Finn and Jake meet a horse with the power to make sad people happy.

episodes.title: Shh!
episodes.summary: Finn and Jake hold a contest to see who can last longer without talking.

episodes.title: The Suitor
episodes.summary: Peppermint Butler thinks Princess Bubblegum is spending too much time in her lab and decides she needs a suitor.

episodes.title: The Party's Over, Isla de Señorita
episodes.summary: His kidnapping scheme foiled again for like the millionth time, Ice King decides he's had enough.

episodes.title: One Last Job
episodes.summary: Jake Jr. gets mixed up with some bad eggs and Jake has to reunite with his old gang for one last job to save him.

episodes.title: Another 5 Short Graybles
episodes.summary: Why are Finn and Jake building a time machine? Can Princess Bubblegum help Cinnamon Bun conquer his fear of the dark?

episodes.title: Candy Streets
episodes.summary: LSP is robbed and faints before she can tell Finn and Jake who robbed her.

episodes.title: Wizards Only, Fools
episodes.summary: Princess Bubblegum believes magic is nothing but a bunch of hooey, but when Starchy gets sick and asks her to use magic to cure him, she asks Finn and Jake to help her sneak into Wizard City to get a cold spell.

episodes.title: Jake Suit
episodes.summary: Jake is sick and tired of Finn using his body as a suit of armor, so he convinces Finn to trade places to show him how much it really stinks.

episodes.title: Be More
episodes.summary: Finn and Jake disguise themselves as MOs in order to infiltrate the MO factory in hopes of saving BMO from malfunctioning.

episodes.title: Sky Witch
episodes.summary: Marceline is on a top-secret mission tracking Maja the Sky Witch. But when she loses the witch's trail, Marceline turns to Princess Bubblegum for help.

episodes.title: Frost & Fire
episodes.summary: After Flame Princess battles Ice King, Finn has an exciting dream. But when it abruptly ends, Finn must get FP and IK to fight again to find out how it ends.

episodes.title: Too Old
episodes.summary: Finn, Jake and PB discover a talented mutant named Lemonsqueak at The Pageant of Mutants. Now they must find a way to free him from the lemongrabs.

episodes.title: Earth & Water
episodes.summary: Princess Bubblegum subjects Flame Princess to a series of tests to gauge FP's fiery tendencies. But when there's an emergency at the treehouse, and PB leaves Cinnamon Bun to watch Flame Princess, her experiment might literally backfire in her face.

episodes.title: Time Sandwich
episodes.summary: Jake crafts the most delicious sandwich ever, but when Magic Man steals it, Finn must defy the laws of space and time to win back Jake's creation.

episodes.title: The Vault
episodes.summary: When Finn starts sleepwalking and dreaming about the Green Lady he filed away in his memory vault, Jake and BMO help him tap into his repressed memories to uncover a secret past. Who is the Green Lady? And how is she connected to Finn?

episodes.title: Love Games
episodes.summary: Slime Princess needs a husband or else she'll lose the Slime Kingdom to her obnoxious sis. Finn steps in to save the day, but first they will need to win a series of Love Games to prove to Slime Princess's dad that they are really in love. This is definitely NOT what Finn signed up for!

episodes.title: Dungeon Train
episodes.summary: All aboard! Finn and Jake discover a train where every car is a dungeon filled with a new foe for Finn to fight. Jake quickly gets bored and wants to leave, but Finn is having the BEST time and doesn't want to leave... ever!

episodes.title: The Box Prince
episodes.summary: Finn meets the Box Prince (a cat with a box on its back) and discovers the Box Kingdom has been taken over by an imposter. Now, Finn must help the real Box Prince reclaim his rightful throne.

episodes.title: Red Starved
episodes.summary: Finn, Jake and Marceline are trapped in an underground cavern with no red in sight. If Marceline doesn't feed, like ASAP, she will turn into a vampiric beast and suck out all of Jake's blood! So, Finn heads off to explore the cave and find something red to satiate her until they can be rescued. But time is running out!

episodes.title: We Fixed a Truck
episodes.summary: Finn finds an old truck, and Jake calls Banana Man to help with the repairs. But when BMO stays up all night working on the truck, he hears on a spooky radio talk show that Princess Bubblegum is a reptilian replicant. Is it just another one of Starchy's crazy conspiracy theories, or a fact?

episodes.title: Play Date
episodes.summary: Sick and tired of babysitting Ice King while the Ice Kingdom is being rebuilt, Finn and Jake call up an old friend to hang out with their annoying houseguest: Abracadaniel. But when Ice King and his new BFF accidentally unleash the demon Kee-Oth, Finn and Jake have to clean up their mess.

episodes.title: The Pit
episodes.summary: Kee-Oth the Blood Demon has kidnapped Jake, taken him back to his dimension and thrown him in a pit. If Finn wants to rescue his friend, he's going to need Lady Rainicorn's help... and a videotape that will reveal how to open the portal to Kee-Oth's messed-up dimension.

episodes.title: James
episodes.summary: Finn & Jake are excited when Princess Bubblegum invites them to help her collect samples in the Desert of Wonders. But when their vessel is attacked by nasty goo monsters, Finn & Jake start to think the mission has been sabotaged by PB's robot helper James.

episodes.title: Root Beer Guy
episodes.summary: Root Beer Guy works a boring job during the day and tries to write mystery stories at night. But his life is about to change when he witnesses Finn & Jake kidnapping Princess Bubblegum! There's only one problem: no one believes Root Beer Guy...

episodes.title: Apple Wedding
episodes.summary: You are cordially invited to the Wedding of the Year! But who will be united in matrimony?

episodes.title: Blade of Grass
episodes.summary: Finn and Jake decide it's time for Finn to get a new sword. Finn reluctantly buys a grass sword from a mysterious old man, but the sword turns out to be cursed! And unfortunately for our hero, all sales are final.

episodes.title: Rattleballs
episodes.summary: Finn practices his sword fighting skills at the candy junkyard, where he meets an old gumball robot named Rattleballs. To Finn's shock, he finds out he's NOT the master swordsman he thinks he is. What the what?! Finn begs Rattleballs to train him, but he soon discovers his mentor's deep, dark secret... a secret that will ultimately test Finn's loyalty to Princess Bubblegum.

episodes.title: The Red Throne
episodes.summary: When Flame King breaks out of his prison and takes over the Flame Kingdom again, Flame Princess turns to the one person she believes she can trust... Finn! But will Finn be able to put his feelings for Flame Princess aside long enough to help her reclaim her throne?

episodes.title: Betty
